title: Umufatanyabikorwa Udacogora mu igeragezwa rya zahabu
intro: Mu gicucu cy'umuhanuzi ukomeye, roho y'ubuhanga mu kuvuga no kwizera yatoranijwe kugira ngo ifashe mu butumwa bukomeye. Uyu muntu yahagaze neza ubwo rubanda rwahindaga umushyitsi, abwiriza kurwanya icyaha cyagaragaraga nk'aho cyari giteye ubwoba ku idini rimwe. Ubwo umuhanuzi yagarukaga kwirebera ikosa ry'abantu, ubwunganizi bw'uyu muntu ntibwari ubwo kwiregura ahubwo bwari ubwo kuba yari afite inshingano zo gutinya amacakubiri. Ni nde mugaragu w'Imana wiyeguriye Imana?
clues: Natowe na Allah ku bw'inshingano zera hamwe n'indi, kandi inshingano zanjye zari izo gushyigikira no gutangaza ubutumwa.
Nahawe ijambo risobanutse neza, maze njyana n'intumwa kugira ngo nhangane n'umurenganya ukomeye.
Mu rugendo rukomeye, intumwa yazamutse umusozi ari wenyine, insigira kurinda abantu.
Ubwo bari bahari, abantu bakoze igishushanyo cya zahabu, maze ndabasaba gukomeza kuba indahemuka, ariko banze inama zanjye.
Ubwo intumwa yagarukaga yuzuye uburakari n'agahinda, narafashwe, ariko nasobanuye ko nari naratsinzwe kandi ko natinyaga guteza amakimbirane hagati yabo.
Ndi umuhanuzi wahagaze iruhande rwa Musa, umuvandimwe wanjye, dusangira umutwaro we kandi tugakomeza gukomera ku gusenga ibigirwamana.
